svg.title: The learning loop
svg.desc: Engraved wheel of five stations around a hub marked make bench and bench/corpus. An incident: flags turn off without a deploy and someone is on call. Every incident review asks which layer should have caught it. The answer becomes a lint rule, a skill line, an AGENTS.md line or a bench case. A bench case is change.diff and expected.json, with the path:line confirmed by an engineer, plus its clean sibling. The reviewer is scored against every case, and a prompt, model or tool change is kept only if the score goes up; then the layers meet the next change. Source: A. Osmani, M. W. Lunt and Q. Wang, “How the Claude Code team does code review”, Anthropic, 15 October 2026, https://claude.dev/blog/solving-code-review-at-anthropic/. Independent implementation, not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
